value.rationale: This is a natural first non-parity-doubled cubic homogeneous Walsh level, not an arbitrary coefficient slice. The full 35-dimensional norm, its exact optimal Hilbert distortion, and an explicit coefficient-magnitude stability remainder are determined by a nontrivial strongly regular triple-intersection graph; this benchmark is useful for degree-level hypercontractivity and finite-dimensional Banach geometry. It does not rely solely on novelty or reproducibility.
